synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO reviews Tasmania’s pre‑dispatch load forecast when the forecast error exceeds the region’s error threshold for consecutive half‑hour periods.

document_statements.quote: Table 5 Pre-dispatch Load Forecasting Error Thresholds Region Forecast Error Threshold (MW) Queensland 100 New South Wales 150 Victoria 100 South Australia 50 Tasmania 50
The load forecast for a region will be reviewed, whenever the forecast error is greater than the forecast error threshold in a region for two consecutive 30-minute periods.
If the forecast error for a region is greater than a threshold limit for greater than two 30- minute periods AEMO may submit a revised forecast for that region.
